messages:
carla: Heads up — the Next.js sample kit we ship in /examples/next-starter is causing confusion during onboarding. Steps: clone, npm install, set REDWOOD_API_KEY. But the LangChain / LlamaIndex examples still import from the old 'redwood' API and the eval harness hits a 401 + retry loop.

sam: Can you paste the error + repro steps?

carla: Repro steps:
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples
2) cd examples/next-starter && yarn && yarn dev
3) open http://localhost:3000 and click the "Test generate" button on /api/generate

Error in server logs: 
```
Error: 401 Unauthorized
    at fetch (/node_modules/node-fetch/index.js:123:15)
    at handleGenerate (/app/pages/api/generate.js:34:12)
Retrying request (1/3)
```

Also the Python LangChain example contains imports like:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
```
but our Python SDK now exposes redwood_ai.client.RedwoodClient (package name changed). So the examples are failing for new users.

sam: Ack. Sounds like two issues: 1) our next starter copies an old env var name (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_TOKEN / REDWOOD_KEY - we should normalize) and 2) LangChain example is outdated. I'll open a PR to fix the starter env var and update the example imports. @ben can you help with docs mapping?

ben: On it — will update README + quickstart. Will add a short compatibility table listing current package names and import lines for Node/TS and Python so folks don't copy the wrong example.

devex-bot: CI pipeline started for branch fix/next-starter-auth-fix — 3 tests running.

carla: :thumbsup: thanks. Also the eval harness (examples/eval/harness.py) uses eval_client.create_run which now raises RateLimitError even when the account is under quota. Stacktrace:
```
redwood.errors.RateLimitError: 429 Too Many Requests
    at eval_client.create_run (/examples/eval/harness.py:22)
```
I suspect a token-count mismatch or a routing fallback causing multiple rapid retries.

sam: Hmm, could be the SDK is sending an incompatible model param and hosted routing falls back and queues. Can you re-run with REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 and paste routing logs?

carla: Pasted relevant debug snippet: 
```
routing: selected model 'gptx-3-large-q8' -> fallback to 'gptx-2' due to capacity
request.retries=2
```
Also opened a tiny PR for the starter fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/42 (updates env var + Node import).

nina: Prioritize the starter auth fix + eval harness flaky — these are key onboarding blockers for new signups. Can we ship a patch and backport to v0.9? ETA?

sam: I'll cut a patch branch now and aim for EOD. Plan: (a) normalize env var names in starter, (b) add backward-compatible env var support in Node SDK for one release, (c) update examples to current imports, (d) add a short troubleshooting note for 401/retry UI hang. Also add a temporary client-side retry cap so the frontend doesn't spin forever.

ben: README updated in PR 42. I added a compatibility table and a troubleshooting section that mentions REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_TOKEN and clear steps to regenerate keys from the console.

devex-bot: CI passed — 3/3. Deployed preview for branch fix/next-starter-auth-fix at https://deploy-preview-42--examples.netlify.app

carla: Verified — frontend no longer infinite loader, example now shows a helpful error if the key is missing. Eval harness still intermittently hits a 429 but much improved. Thanks team.

sam: Follow-up action: I'll file a tiny RFC to unify SDK package/import names and add a docs warning to the SDK release notes. Also will add an integ test for the eval harness to catch the routing-fallback pattern.

ben: I'll cherry-pick the README fix to the docs-site branch and sync with product.

carla: Leaving a note: if anyone else hits this, run `export REDWOOD_DEBUG=1` and check the routing logs — the fallback shows up clearly.

nina: Thanks all. Please add the backport PR link here when ready so I can track for the next release notes.
